basics.summary: Doctoral candidate specializing in socio-affective touch in robotics, with a strong background in medical robotics, signal processing, and optimization. Experienced in leading research projects and developing innovative robotic solutions.

publications.name: Human Hand Shape and Grasping Behavior Estimation using a Humanoid Hand with a Tactile Interface
publications.publisher: Human Hand Shape and Grasping Behavior Estimation using a Humanoid Hand with a Tactile Interface
publications.summary: Published in collaboration with Tapus, A. (2025). In this work, we introduce a novel method for estimating both human hand geometry and grasping style using a tactile sensory humanoid hand.

publications.name: "Oh! It's Fun Chatting with You!" A Humor-aware Social Robot Chat Framework
publications.publisher: IEEE-RAS International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
publications.summary: Published in collaboration with Zhang, H., García Cárdenas, J.J., Hei, X., Tapus, A. (2024). This work introduces a framework for social robots that can engage in humor-aware conversations.

publications.name: Designing a Haptic Interface for Enhanced Non-Verbal Human-Robot Interaction: Integrating Heart and Lung Emotional Feedback
publications.publisher: IEEE-RAS International Conference on Humanoid Robots
publications.summary: Published with Liu, Y., Tapus, A. (2024). This paper focuses on creating a haptic interface for humanoid robots to convey emotional feedback through heart and lung simulations, enhancing non-verbal interaction.

publications.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing Guidance Using a Humanoid Robot With a Soft Robotic Haptic Interface for Anxiety Reduction
publications.publisher: Human Hand Shape and Grasping Behavior Estimation using a Humanoid Hand with a Tactile Interface
publications.summary: Authored with Liu, Y., Zhang, H., Tapus, A. (2024). This research explores using a humanoid robot with a soft haptic interface to guide diaphragmatic breathing for anxiety reduction.

publications.name: Full Coverage and Optimal Planner for Blood-Brain Barrier Permeabilization using Focused Ultrasound Cavitation
publications.summary: Research conducted with Vappou, J - Nageotte. F - Larrat, B., focusing on optimizing planning for focused ultrasound applications.

publications.name: Focused Ultrasound Sonication With Mechanical and Electronic Steering Along a Computed Trajectory
publications.summary: Patent application with Vappou, J - Nageotte. F - Larrat, B., describing a method for steering focused ultrasound.

publications.name: COVID-19 lung CT image segmentation using deep learning methods: U-Net versus SegNet
publications.summary: Investigated and compared U-Net and SegNet deep learning techniques for semantic segmentation of COVID-19 infected tissue in CT lung images.

publications.name: Two Proposed Indoor Multi-Cameras Positioning Systems Compared to Classical Geometry System
publications.publisher: IEEE International Conference on Advanced Science and Sustainable Development Applications (ICASSDA)
publications.summary: Presented research on indoor positioning systems using multi-cameras, comparing them to classical geometry approaches.

projects.name: Tactile Array for Humanoid Hand to enable socio-affective touch
projects.summary: Design, manufacturing, and validation of a tactile array embedded in a silicon-based substrate for humanoid hands, part of my thesis research.

projects.name: Robotic Assistance for Blood-Brain Barrier Opening using Focused Ultrasound
projects.summary: Designed and optimized robot path planning using ROS2 on Universal Robots UR5 for improving accuracy and precision in this promising breakthrough in brain medicine.

projects.name: ROS2 Driver for NDI medical-grade visual localization system using ros2-control
projects.summary: Developed drivers for `ros2_control` to facilitate communication with NDI localization systems, crucial for performance-critical applications.

projects.name: Design and Implementation of a SWARM motion planning algorithm based on fluid dynamics
projects.summary: Developed a novel motion planning algorithm for a swarm of non-holonomic robots based on the numerical solution of Navier-Stokes’s equations. Also created a swarm platform of 15 mobile robots.

projects.name: COVID-19 Lung CT Image Segmentation using Deep Learning
projects.summary: Investigated and compared SegNet and U-NET deep learning techniques for semantic segmentation of COVID-19 infected tissue regions in CT lung images.
